segments.t: De vuelta en la posada Linden Courtyard Inn, Graham pela un cable de cobre nuevo sentado en un taburete cuando Arthur se acerca al mostrador de recepción, radiante de orgullo tras su supuesta ganga telefónica. Escucha primero toda la escena.
Congratulate me, Graham! I found folding wooden garden chairs at half price!
Half price? Why do I already feel nervous when you say 'half price'?
Because the shop only gives that price if you order two dozen at once!
Two dozen?! Arthur, two dozen is twenty-four chairs!
Twelve for Room Nine, eight spares for the courtyard, and four for... emergencies!
Where on earth do we store twenty-four chairs while we paint all week?!
Relax! I told the driver to bring them next Thursday afternoon.
Wait, who just backed a delivery van up to our front gate?
A blue van? Why does the side say 'Garden Chairs Express'?!
Let me read your notepad... boss, you circled 'Saturday two o'clock'!
I read the wrong column without my glasses! They are unloading them now!
Twenty-four wooden chairs in our narrow courtyard. Wonderful, boss!
Repasemos ahora cada frase del diálogo.
Congratulate me, Graham! I found folding wooden garden chairs at half price!
'¡Felicítame, Graham! ¡Encontré sillas plegables de jardín de madera a mitad de precio!'
Half price? Why do I already feel nervous when you say 'half price'?
'¿Mitad de precio? ¿Por qué ya me pongo nervioso cuando dices "mitad de precio"?'
Because the shop only gives that price if you order two dozen at once!
'¡Porque la tienda solo da ese precio si pides dos docenas de una vez!'
Two dozen?! Arthur, two dozen is twenty-four chairs!
'¿¡Dos docenas!? ¡Arthur, dos docenas son veinticuatro sillas!'
Twelve for Room Nine, eight spares for the courtyard, and four for... emergencies!
'¡Doce para la habitación nueve, ocho de repuesto para el patio y cuatro para... emergencias!'
Where on earth do we store twenty-four chairs while we paint all week?!
'¿¡Dónde diablos guardamos veinticuatro sillas mientras pintamos toda la semana!?'
Relax! I told the driver to bring them next Thursday afternoon.
'¡Tranquilo! Le dije al repartidor que las trajera el próximo jueves por la tarde.'
Wait, who just backed a delivery van up to our front gate?
'Espera, ¿quién acaba de dar marcha atrás con una furgoneta de reparto hasta nuestra reja de entrada?'
A blue van? Why does the side say 'Garden Chairs Express'?!
'¿Una furgoneta azul? ¿¡Por qué el costado dice "Garden Chairs Express"!?'
Let me read your notepad... boss, you circled 'Saturday two o'clock'!
'Déjame leer tu libreta... jefe, ¡rodeaste con un círculo "sábado a las dos en punto"!'
I read the wrong column without my glasses! They are unloading them now!
'¡Leí la columna equivocada sin mis gafas! ¡Las están descargando ahora mismo!'
Twenty-four wooden chairs in our narrow courtyard. Wonderful, boss!
'Veinticuatro sillas de madera en nuestro patio estrecho. ¡Maravilloso, jefe!'
Escuchemos otra vez toda la escena a ritmo natural.
Congratulate me, Graham! I found folding wooden garden chairs at half price!
Half price? Why do I already feel nervous when you say 'half price'?
Because the shop only gives that price if you order two dozen at once!
Two dozen?! Arthur, two dozen is twenty-four chairs!
Twelve for Room Nine, eight spares for the courtyard, and four for... emergencies!
Where on earth do we store twenty-four chairs while we paint all week?!
Relax! I told the driver to bring them next Thursday afternoon.
Wait, who just backed a delivery van up to our front gate?
A blue van? Why does the side say 'Garden Chairs Express'?!
Let me read your notepad... boss, you circled 'Saturday two o'clock'!
I read the wrong column without my glasses! They are unloading them now!
Twenty-four wooden chairs in our narrow courtyard. Wonderful, boss!

Por no ponerse las gafas, Arthur pidió veinticuatro sillas para el sábado a las dos en vez del jueves, ¡y la furgoneta ya las está descargando frente a la reja! Veamos la cara de las chicas al regresar.
See you soon!
